The '''Nocto system''' wasa [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Airam sector/Legends|Airam sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nocto]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], it was site of a major [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Telgorn shipyard|shipyard]] named [[Calenz]] that was [[Battle of Nocto|attacked]] by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Task Force Vengeance/Legends|Task Force ''Vengeance'']].<ref name="XWvTF:BoP" />
